description: Yangnyeom Korean Fried Chicken is a beloved dish featuring incredibly crispy fried chicken coated in a luscious, sticky, sweet, and spicy sauce. This popular street food and comfort meal offers a perfect balance of flavors and textures, making it an irresistible treat for any occasion. Each bite delivers a satisfying crunch followed by a burst of savory, tangy, and subtly fiery notes that will leave you craving more.

ingredients.notes: cut into drumettes and flats, or bite-sized pieces

instructions.title: Prepare and Season Chicken
instructions.text: Clean the chicken pieces thoroughly and pat them completely dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, season the chicken with salt, black pepper, ginger powder, and garlic powder. Toss to coat evenly and let it sit for 10-15 minutes.

instructions.title: Prepare the Batter
instructions.text: In a separate large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, cornstarch, and baking powder. In another small bowl, whisk the cold water and egg until well combined. Gradually pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, stirring just until a thick, lumpy batter forms. Do not overmix; a few lumps are desirable for crispiness.

instructions.title: First Fry the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pot or Dutch oven to 340F (170C). Dip each chicken piece into the batter, ensuring it is fully coated. Carefully place the battered chicken into the hot oil, frying in batches to avoid overcrowding. Fry for 6-8 minutes until the chicken is light golden and cooked through. Remove the chicken and drain on a wire rack set over a baking sheet.

instructions.title: Prepare the Yangnyeom Sauce
instructions.text: While the chicken is frying, combine gochujang, ketchup, soy sauce, honey or corn syrup, rice vinegar, minced garlic, minced fresh ginger, sesame oil, brown sugar (if using), and 2 tablespoons of water in a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens slightly, about 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

instructions.title: Second Fry for Crispy Perfection
instructions.text: Increase the oil temperature to 375F (190C). Return the first-fried chicken pieces to the hotter oil and fry for another 2-4 minutes. This second fry is crucial for achieving that signature extra-crispy Korean fried chicken texture. The chicken should be deeply golden brown and audibly crispy. Remove and drain thoroughly on the wire rack.

instructions.title: Coat and Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Immediately transfer the hot, double-fried chicken to a large mixing bowl. Pour the warm Yangnyeom sauce over the chicken. Using tongs or a spatula, toss the chicken gently but quickly until every piece is evenly coated with the sticky, flavorful sauce. Garnish generously with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy the irresistible crunch and flavor!

tips: For the crispiest chicken, double-frying is essential. The first fry cooks the chicken, and the second fry at a higher temperature creates that signature crunch.
Adjust the spice level of the Yangnyeom sauce by increasing or decreasing the amount of gochujang. For a sweeter sauce, add more honey or corn syrup.
Serve Yangnyeom chicken immediately after coating to enjoy its maximum crispiness and the full flavor of the warm sauce. It pairs wonderfully with pickled radishes (mu-saengchae) and a cold beer.
